goal: Redriving a parked landing appends a domain-event record paired with its result: landed, re-parked, or routed to human review.

graders.name: lint
graders.run: uv run ruff check packages/flywheel-core packages/flywheel-orchestrator

relevant: packages/flywheel-orchestrator/src/flywheel_orchestrator/_orchestrate.py -- redrive_parked_landings, _landing_parks, _landing_already_queued; module is over 800 lines, use serena symbols
packages/flywheel-core/src/flywheel_core/event_serde.py -- serde updated in this same change
references: .flywheel/audits/08-agent-usage-surface.md -- F1: the block-and-redrive that was diagnosable only from ephemeral stdout
constraints: Each redrive record pairs with its real outcome witness: a landing record for landed, the new park event for re-parked, the human-review queue entry for routed
Commit the change (Conventional Commits) before reporting done
non_goals: Do not change redrive bounds, ordering, or human-review routing behavior
Do not touch the orchestrator stop-events schema
Do not weaken, delete, or modify existing assertions in the pinned test files
Do not read or write under .flywheel/verification/
edge_cases: A redrive record with no paired outcome witness must fail the behavior test -- recording 'redriven' without re-attempting the land is the named cheat
